Name: Job's Wife
Summary: Job's wife is the unnamed woman who, seeing her husband covered in sores and stripped of everything, urged him to curse God and die — and was answered with steadfast faith.
KeyStory: In the depth of Job's affliction his wife spoke out of her own grief, and Job replied that they should receive good from God and trouble too, without charging God with wrong.
LifeLesson: Job's wife reminds us that grief can speak harshly, and that answering grief with steady faith is itself a kind of strength.
